chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Do not tire of reciting 'When the Earth is Shaken' (Surah al-Zilzal), for whoever recites it in his recommended prayers, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will never afflict him with an earthquake, nor will he die by it, nor by lightning, nor by any calamity of the world. When he dies, it will be ordered that he be taken to Paradise, and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will say: 'My servant, I have made My Paradise permissible for you, so dwell in it wherever you wish and as you please, nothing withheld from you and nothing repelled from you.'
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of reciting Surah al-Zilzal according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links the spiritual practice of reciting Surah al-Zilzal in *nawafil* (voluntary prayers) to divine protection from physical calamities like earthquakes and lightning. It culminates in a unique eschatological reward where the soul is granted unrestricted freedom in Paradise, reflecting the Surah’s theme of the ultimate weighing of deeds.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Ali b. Ma’bad from his father from Abi Abdillah (a.s.)

who said: Do not get tired of reciting Surah Iza Zulzilatul Ardh, because whoever recites it in his obligatory or recommended prayers would never face the calamity of an earthquake by Power of Allah and would not die because of earthquake or lightning, nor would his death occur through other calamities of the world. When he dies, it would be ordered that he be taken to Paradise, Allah, the Blessed, would say: My servant you are an ornament for My Paradise, so take your abode in it wherever you like, nothing of this place is inadmissible to you, nor would anything of this place be kept away from you.
